mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen(run_id,source_id,business_key,source_updated_at,source_hash) values(#{runId},#{sourceId},#{businessKey},#{updatedAt},#{hash}) on conflict(run_id,source_id) do update set source_updated_at=excluded.source_updated_at, source_hash=excluded.source_hash,observed_at=clock_timestamp()

insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff(run_id,business_key,source_id,difference_type, source_updated_at,target_updated_at,source_hash,target_hash,repaired,verification_status,repair_status,detail,verified_at,repaired_at) values(#{runId},#{businessKey},#{sourceId},#{differenceType},#{sourceUpdatedAt},#{targetUpdatedAt}, #{sourceHash},#{targetHash},#{repaired},#{verificationStatus},#{repairStatus},#{detail},clock_timestamp(), case when #{repaired} then clock_timestamp() else null end) on conflict(run_id,business_key) do nothing
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff d set verification_status=case when #{applied} then 'CONFIRMED' else 'RESOLVED_BY_RECHECK' end, repair_status=case when #{applied} then 'REPAIRED' else 'NOT_REQUESTED' end, repaired=#{applied},verified_at=clock_timestamp(), repaired_at=case when #{applied} then clock_timestamp() else d.repaired_at end from integration_schema.job_run r where r.run_id=d.run_id and r.job_code=#{jobCode} and r.mode='RECONCILE' and d.source_id=#{sourceId} and d.run_id<>#{repairRunId} and d.repaired=false and d.verification_status<>'RESOLVED_BY_RECHECK'
mapper.select: select d.source_id from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff d join integration_schema.job_run r on r.run_id=d.run_id where d.id=#{id} and r.job_code=#{jobCode} and r.mode='RECONCILE'
select * from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} order by id limit 100
